line: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra (2026, NVIDIA RTX Spark)
config_name: Surface Laptop Ultra 15" — NVIDIA RTX Spark (N1X), 24GB LPDDR5x, 512GB SSD, Mini-LED touch

specs.cpu: NVIDIA RTX Spark N1X (Arm, 20-core) — 18-core variant on some SKUs

battery.notes: Reviewers flag battery as the weak point ('battery life is disappointing' — IT Pro); ~9h light use estimated.

offers.name: Microsoft Surface Laptop Ultra 15" Touchscreen Laptop - NVIDIA RTX Spark - 24GB LPDDR5x RAM - 512GB SSD - Win11 Home - En - Platinum

reviews.quote: isn't the MacBook Pro killer I hoped for
has all the on-device AI your devs need – but its battery life is disappointing

praises: RTX Spark's Blackwell GPU + CUDA on Arm finally makes thin-and-light video/AI work genuinely fast
Mini-LED 15" HDR panel (1,600-nit peaks) is the best display Microsoft has shipped
24GB unified memory headroom runs local LLMs that 16GB x86 ultrabooks can't
First-class dev tooling: CUDA on Windows Arm works in PyTorch now
Build quality and keyboard are classic Surface — rigid, quiet, comfortable
complaints: Battery life is the Achilles heel reviewers keep citing — ~9h real use for a $3,900 machine
Arm Windows translation gaps remain for some pro apps and games despite NVIDIA's drivers
Base 512GB at this price is stingy; Microsoft storage tax again
Heavier than Surface Laptop 8 (~1.65 kg) and charger is a brick
TechRadar's 'not the MacBook Pro killer' sums it: M5-class rivals beat it on perf-per-watt

design_philosophy: Microsoft's halo machine: an Arm Windows ultrabook rebuilt around NVIDIA's RTX Spark SoC to prove local AI and CUDA-class GPU power belong in a 1.6 kg clamshell. The 24GB/512GB tier is the entry to that vision.
rating_notes: Ratings anchored on SL Ultra reviews (TechRadar/IT Pro/TweakTown headlines verified in NOTES; full pages 403). RTX Spark N1X: ai_ml 9.5 (CUDA + unified mem), gaming 6.5 (Blackwell iGPU class), battery penalised to 5.5 per consistent 'disappointing' verdicts. ARM ecosystem 7.0 (slightly better than Snapdragon thanks to NVIDIA GPU stack).
